benchmark.name: Aider Polyglot

summary.en: Aider Polyglot tests whether a model can edit code correctly across six programming languages.
summary.zh: Aider Polyglot 测试模型能不能在六种编程语言中正确修改代码。

task_format.en: The model receives an Exercism coding exercise and must make the requested repository edit using Aider's editing format.
task_format.zh: 模型会收到一个 Exercism 编程题，需要用 Aider 要求的编辑格式修改代码仓库。

explanation.en: A task counts as correct when the resulting code passes the benchmark checks. The score is the percentage of exercises completed correctly.
explanation.zh: 修改后的代码通过 benchmark 检查，这道题才算正确。分数就是正确完成 exercise 的比例。

cost_per_task.method: median of reported full-run costs divided by the documented 225-task benchmark size
cost_per_task.notes: Cost varies by model, harness, and inference settings.

unavailable: T80: not included in the first vertical slice
benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
